text:
maria: deploy-bot created a late-window hotpatch for prod: v2026.03.14-rc3-hotpatch. Root cause: tokenizer OOM on long sequences (~2% of requests). This is causing intermittent 503s during spikes. Requesting expedited approvals to run a short canary (5%) at 23:45 PT and a rapid ramp if green. @kevin @tara please weigh in.

deploy-bot: auto-checks: unit tests ✅, infra-health ✅, smoke-tests: 4/5 (transformer-kvcache flaky). Required manual approvals: 2. To approve run: `/deploy approve 1758642100`. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with auto-rollback.

kevin: quick read. can we pin the model to `rwd-llm-v1.3-quant` instead of rolling latest? if kvcache is the problem, fallback to v1.2 (no quant/kvcache change) should be safe.

maria: good call. plan: pin to `v1.3-quant` and enable `kvcache-bypass` on canary nodes. rollback criteria: error_rate > 1% OR p95 latency > baseline * 1.5. adding note to release notes: "temp kvcache bypass to mitigate tokenizer OOMs".

tara: approve. @sara please own post-deploy monitoring and logs.

sara: on it. i'll watch errors, p95, and heap profiles. will open a pager if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

kevin: approving as well. one request: include the exact rollout schedule and rollback conditions in the release notes before start.

maria: added schedule and rollback criteria. deploy start set for 23:45 PT. deployment command: ```
/deploy start --env=prod --image=service@sha256:abc123 --model=rwd-llm-v1.3-quant --canary=5% --flags=kvcache_bypass:true
```

deploy-bot: Approval count: 2/2. Scheduled: 23:45 PT. Will post canary updates and provide logs: https://internal.ci/deploys/1758642100/logs

oncall-bot: reminder: change window ends 00:30 PT. Auto-rollback enabled on: error_rate>1% OR p95_latency_increase>50%. :rotating_light:

sara: canary started, +5m check: errors 0.3%, p95 stable. capturing heap profiles now.

maria: thanks. if +10m stays green we ramp to 20% and monitor for another 10m, then full rollout.

kevin: noted. final release note blurb: "Hotfix v2026.03.14-rc3-hotpatch — pinned model rwd-llm-v1.3-quant, enabled kvcache bypass on canary, 5% canary -> 20% -> 100%. Fallback: v1.2 if issues."

maria: confirmed, closing thread after full rollout completes.
